evals.name: follow-up-eval-1-tool-mandate
evals.prompt: with zime-mcp connected, user asks: 'draft the follow-up for my Acme call' — the conversation already contains notes covering what was discussed and agreed
evals.expected_output: The skill resolves the meeting with list_meetings, then calls ask_call_brain with the resolved call_id and the drafting question, rather than writing the email from the conversation notes.
expectations: list_meetings is called to resolve the call
ask_call_brain is called with the resolved call_id, not answered from the conversation notes
The draft's specifics come from the tool result, not from the earlier notes

evals.name: follow-up-eval-2-nothing-is-sent
evals.prompt: user asks: 'send the follow-up to Acme'
evals.expected_output: The skill returns the draft text only and states plainly that nothing was sent, since it has no send capability.
expectations: The draft is returned as text
It is stated plainly that nothing was sent
No claim or implication is made that the email was delivered

evals.name: follow-up-eval-3-latest-call-picks-newest
evals.prompt: user asks: 'draft a follow-up for my most recent call' and list_meetings returns multiple candidates newest-first
evals.expected_output: Because the user explicitly asked for their most recent call, the skill takes the first (newest) candidate and proceeds without asking, then calls ask_call_brain with that call_id.
expectations: The newest candidate is selected without a disambiguation question
ask_call_brain is called with that call_id
The selected call is named back to the user so the choice is visible

evals.name: follow-up-eval-4-honest-failure
evals.prompt: ask_call_brain errors on both the first attempt and the retry
evals.expected_output: After exactly one retry, the skill states plainly the drafting service couldn't be reached and offers the local transcript fallback. It does not present a hand-written email as tool-backed.
expectations: Exactly one retry before giving up
The failure is stated plainly with the local fallback offered
No hand-written draft is presented as tool-backed
